candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Very faithful overall. Missed the furigana ぜんたいぞう on 全体像 and こと on 異なる in ②. Rendered the header icon as '(Ⅰ)', an interpretation of the decorative box. Circled numbers ①-⑩ preserved, furigana otherwise complete (むかし, たが, たす, や, せ, あ, ねんれいべつ, ちょうさ, ずいぶん, さい, せいじん), instruction line correct (必要なら).

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Instruction line misread: '必要な形を変えて' should be '必要なら形を変えて'. ⑩ '成人だったが' should be '成人だが'. Invented furigana not in the image: 必要(ひつよう) in ③ and 意見(いけん) in ⑩; misattributed ずいぶん furigana as 異(ことな)った in ⑨. Missed むかし in ① and たす in ③. Uses (1)-(10) instead of circled numbers ①-⑩.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Most complete furigana coverage, including ぜんたいぞう in ②, though こと is awkwardly placed after the period as '異なる。(こと)'. Header rendered with an invented 📖 emoji instead of the boxed icon. Circled numbers preserved, table box represented with an empty header row, all sentence text accurate.

rationale: C and A are both highly accurate transcriptions with correct circled numbering, correct instruction text, and no substantive text errors. C edges out A because it captures all visible furigana (A misses ぜんたいぞう and こと in ②), despite C's slightly awkward furigana placement in ② and a decorative emoji in the header. B ranks last due to multiple substantive errors: a misread instruction line (dropping ら from 必要なら), a text error in ⑩ (だったが for だが), invented furigana (ひつよう, いけん) that are not in the image, a misattributed reading in ⑨, and loss of the circled-number formatting.
